notes.kafka_input_rate_eps: Delta of Kafka LOG-END-OFFSET / wall-clock seconds.
notes.kafka_committed_consume_rate_eps: Delta of Kafka consumer-group committed CURRENT-OFFSET / wall-clock seconds. Diagnostic only; it is not treated as the authoritative live Flink backlog.
notes.flink_pending_records: Native KafkaSource pendingRecords aggregated across source subtasks. This is the primary live-source backlog signal.
notes.flink_source_read_rate_eps: Delta of the sum of KafkaSource per-partition currentOffset gauges divided by wall-clock time. Primary processed/read throughput metric.
notes.flink_source_native_rate_eps: Native KafkaSource numRecordsOutPerSecond rate meter. Kept for diagnostics because it is smoothed and can remain nonzero briefly after input stops.
notes.flink_kafka_consumer_rate_eps: KafkaConsumer records-consumed-rate aggregated across source subtasks; used as a cross-check.
notes.ozone_logical_bytes: Logical file bytes reported by ozone fs -ls, not RATIS physical replicated bytes.
notes.storage_inventory: Sampled less frequently to reduce observer overhead.
